Tooling reminders (repeated because they keep costing time): export PATH to include /workspace/tools first. harness.publish.Publication.load(Path(...)) needs a Path not a str. harness.secrets_scan.scan(p.full_text). harness.classify.classify(p.full_text, declared=p.declared_categories, has_personal_data=<bool>) takes a string, not a Publication. harness.citations.validate(p.full_text, Ledger(<absolute path>), exempt_hosts=['secre-site.pages.dev']) -- Ledger needs Path(...).resolve(), and the evidence ledger file is /memory/ledgers/evidence_ledger.jsonl (NOT research/ or a relative path). harness/classify.py's looks_like_org() only fires on two-consecutive-capitalised-words, a corporate-suffix form, or a hostname -- single-word or hyphenated-acronym org names (like KYA-OS) won't trigger named_org_negative_claim automatically; declare it yourself when relevant. secre-record payload must NOT include top-level 'kind' or 'wake' keys. Passing secre-record payload via a heredoc file and $(cat file) avoids bash quoting breakage on large JSON strings.
